comments.author: RuKira
comments.body_html:
It’s not fully done, but the mod itself basically changes all attachments to fit the current Live Standard changes.

BSG has been changing all attachments to have punishing returns, and making it less about what attachments you have, and more about what barrel you have. When you build your guns look at stats. (You can also see the full changes in SPT\user\mods\AttachmentBackport\Data\attachmentChanges.json)

As for why it’s not done, I still need to work on Aiming, Noise, and some other stuff.
